# Scrobble.dev

> Plain-language, source-linked guidance for turning media activity into durable history.

Canonical site: https://scrobble.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/Electric-Town/scrobble.dev
Language: en
Last revised: 2026-08-11

## Field guide

- [Scrobbling definition](https://scrobble.dev/learn/scrobbling/): Definition, history and distinctions.
- [Learn index](https://scrobble.dev/learn/): Guides for tracker users.
- [Media activity lifecycle](https://scrobble.dev/learn/lifecycle/): Now playing, progress, durable history and completion.
- [Build reliable scrobbling](https://scrobble.dev/build/): Event boundaries, native progress, safe retry, correction and export.
- [Draft principles](https://scrobble.dev/standard/): Scrobble.dev discussion draft 0.1.

## Project catalogue

- [Scrobbling projects](https://scrobble.dev/projects/): Source-linked comparison by media type and project category.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://scrobble.dev/faq/): Anime as a catalogue facet, tracker differences, portable records and catalogue licensing.
- [Project catalogue in JSON](https://scrobble.dev/projects.json): CC0 catalogue distribution.
- [Project catalogue in CSV](https://scrobble.dev/projects.csv): CC0 tabular distribution.
- [Project catalogue in OKF v0.2 Markdown](https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/projects.md): Portable, source-linked catalogue data.
- [Floppy implementation notes](https://scrobble.dev/projects/floppy/): Software used to test the draft guidance.

## Portable knowledge

- [Knowledge index](https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/index.md)
- [FAQ concept](https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/faq.md)
- [Scrobbling concept](https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/concepts/scrobbling.md)
- [Evidence method](https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/method.md)
- [Governance](https://scrobble.dev/knowledge/governance.md)
- [Open Knowledge Format project](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog/tree/main/okf)
- [Pinned OKF v0.2 specification](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog/blob/374e0bc4c644310ff56cdf9c0fe81eccdec862b0/okf/SPEC.md)
- [Expanded site context](https://scrobble.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Contribution

- [Improve Scrobble.dev](https://github.com/Electric-Town/scrobble.dev): Definitions, project evidence and field-guide corrections.
- [Work on Floppy](https://github.com/dannyvfilms/Floppy/issues): Reproducible tracking failures, fixtures, tests and code.
- [Work on FloppyDesktop](https://github.com/Electric-Town/FloppyDesktop/issues): Native desktop integration and packaging.

Prefer first-party sources, reproducible examples, explicit provenance, stable identifiers and versioned semantics. Do not infer consensus where behaviour is project-specific.
